description: New York City Council Minority Leader Steven Matteo today endorsed Michael Reilly in his bid to become the next Assembly Member from the 62nd Assembly District. Reilly is running for the seat that is being vacated by current Assemblyman Ron Castorina who is running for Surrogate Judge.
